description: Canonical PATH and binary-location policy for the Windows fleet. Tokens: {UserHome} is the real profile (never the redirected agent home), {CargoHome} is CARGO_HOME from the registry, {LocalAppData} is the real local app data.

forbiddenReasons.C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin: MSYS ssh.exe and scp.exe would shadow Windows OpenSSH.
forbiddenReasons.{UserHome}\\.cargo\\bin: Legacy cargo home. CARGO_HOME is the canonical home (see ~/.agents/RUST_TOOLING.md) and its bin directory is on PATH instead.

forbiddenPatternReason: Agent homes are per-session and deleted later. The dotnet SDK appends the .dotnet tools directory of the profile to the user PATH on first run, which in an agent session is a path inside an agent home.

DTM-WORK.reason: dtm-work keeps ~/bin and ~/.local/bin in the machine PATH for services and sshd, and its ~/bin wrappers (python.cmd, npm.cmd) are deliberate; only dedupe, remove dead entries and add the cargo bin to the machine PATH.

intentionalShadows.bash: Git bash must win over the WSL launcher in System32 and the WindowsApps stub.
intentionalShadows.cmd: Rust launcher that hands off to Microsoft cmd.exe.
intentionalShadows.where: Rust where with JSON output and PATHEXT handling.
intentionalShadows.sort: uutils sort from the coreutils manifest in ~/bin.
intentionalShadows.more: uutils more from the coreutils manifest in ~/bin.
intentionalShadows.expand: uutils expand from the coreutils manifest in ~/bin.
intentionalShadows.tree: Rust tree with junction and long path support.
intentionalShadows.python: uv-managed shim so that python never resolves to the WindowsApps stub.
intentionalShadows.python3: uv-managed shim so that python3 never resolves to the WindowsApps stub.
intentionalShadows.docker: docker.cmd adds MCP modes and passes everything else to docker.exe.
intentionalShadows.codex: Wrapper for the npm codex shim.
intentionalShadows.gemini: Superseded by the Antigravity CLI; forwards to agy.
intentionalShadows.gcloud: Wrapper sets DisableDelayedExpansion before calling the Cloud SDK.
intentionalShadows.gswin64c: Finds the newest Ghostscript under Program Files, so the versioned install path never goes stale.
intentionalShadows.usbipd: A 170 KB shim in ~/bin, not a copy of the usbipd-win binary.
intentionalShadows.claude: Launcher that sets up agent homes. claude.exe is the real binary.
intentionalShadows.cargo: Rustup proxy in ~/bin; cargo.ps1 is the CargoTools-aware wrapper for PowerShell.
